deviations_from_card: (1) Commit order: view.ts, then TV/phone/test bar, then driver, then the test commit last, so every commit is green on its own. The brief asks for test then feat. Red-before was measured on the tree before building: 8/8 red, with the two GUARDs red only because view.ts did not exist. (2) The card's Playwright capture against a second dev server was replaced by a server-render parity check. The old LingaTV (HEAD) and the new one were rendered with react-dom/server over 34 session fixtures, and the markup is byte-identical in 34/34. I did not start a dev server because this worktree's next.config has no DESK_NEXT_DIST_DIR and tv-surface A was working in the same tree. Menu and picker states are local React state and not covered by SSR; the case-5 sweep covers them. (3) The view shape adds footer (Menu, Repeat audio), phone (actions that take a value or exist only on the phone), audible, waiting, baseCaption, error and details beside the card's fields. view.answer is flat, {id:'answer', action, label, lastTurnId?, taskId?}. (4) Case 1's check that 'the phone StartPanel renders all six states' is a source check: StartPanel switches on lingaHome with a case per HOME_STATES member. The resume and check-part-way cases are only reached if the phone's router sends them there; today the router gives an active conversation or check its own panel. (5) Extra behaviour change in the driver: it no longer offers every menu entry flat on home. It offers 'menu' and then the menu view, like the TV, and actions that leave Linga (phone-setup, sentence-help) are filtered out. (6) A no-model smoke run of the LT child walked J1-J3 to 'done' (codex and the tutor stubbed via a preload in the OS temp dir). No live model call was made.
notes: For linga B (wave 3): the caption tag and the 'Give me a cue' label live in desk/src/lib/english/view.ts, in the final `else if (c)` branch of lingaView (captionTag = c.cue ? "A little support" : ...; act("cue", "Give me a cue", ...)). The phone's own 'Give me a cue' button is still in LingaPhone.tsx's conversation panel, not the view. For a new action id, add it to VIEW_ACTION_IDS. Case 6 fails otherwise, and the driver enum follows automatically. For uat A (wave 4): exported names are lingaView(session, ui?) -> LingaView, lingaHome(session) -> HomeState, HOME_STATES, VIEW_ACTION_IDS, NO_UI, offeredActions(view) = [...view.actions, ...view.footer, ...view.phone], viewText(view), activeCheck(session). 'Offered' in the driver is offeredActions(view), minus navs that leave Linga, collapsed by id: repeated ids like choose, swap and pick-phrase become one entry that needs option or topicId. When view.answer is set, 'answer' (needs text) is added. The driver's decide enum is actionIds() = [...VIEW_ACTION_IDS, 'done'], exported from uat/driver/linga-text.cjs. Requiring that file runs nothing (require.main guard). An action's run is data: {command?:{action,extra}, nav?:{screen,from?}, ui?:Partial<LingaUi>, focus?, after?}. `after` is a UI patch applied only when the command succeeds. The driver keeps its own ui ({menu,picking,sceneIndex,chapter}) and resets it at each journey start. I did not edit desk/src/app/tv/page.tsx: LingaTV and LingaTestBar kept their props. Drifts closed: Resume sends 'resume'; the recap lists the moments; the test bar answers during the quiz; 'See my topics' routes the same way everywhere; the phone home has plan-done; all 8 menu entries are reachable in LT (6 are Linga-internal).
